items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: So we would battle, maybe Bunny Berigan was forming a band then, playing the territories.

ctx.x: And they had what they called Battles of Music. So we would battle, maybe Bunny Berigan was forming a band then, playing the territories. And Battles of Music was something that would draw a lot of musicians and people; they'd come to see what one band would do against another. We had Battles of Music with Shaw against Red Norvo and his whole band, and so forth and so on.
I've seen in some of the jazz magazines and some of the jazz histories that you left the business for two years, from 1945 to 1947 -- is that so?
